note: Curated by hand: category, type, display name and a description in our own words; builds (default 3.3.5a). skip = left out by policy, with why (licence, game-format and patch-file skips are re-checked every build).

seeds.name: AzerothCore
seeds.description: The open 3.3.5a server core most realm modules here are written for: world, auth and database, with a module system.

seeds.name: TrinityCore (3.3.5 branch)
seeds.description: Long-running open server core; its 3.3.5 branch runs Wrath realms and is the base AzerothCore grew from.

seeds.name: CMaNGOS WotLK
seeds.description: The CMaNGOS server core for 3.3.5a, with its own scripting and a focus on accurate behaviour.

seeds.name: AzerothCore in Docker
seeds.description: Run a whole realm (database, auth and world servers) from ready-made Docker images and one compose file.

seeds.name: Individual Progression
seeds.description: Each player moves through the game's content eras on their own, from the level 60 raids onward, on one shared realm.

seeds.name: Progression System
seeds.description: Opens content in phases across the whole realm, with tuned bosses and loot per phase, for progression-style realms.

seeds.name: Hardcore Mode
seeds.description: Opt-in permadeath with hardcore and ironman rules, milestone rewards and seasons.

seeds.name: Dungeon Master
seeds.description: Generates random dungeon runs: pick a theme and difficulty, then fight scaled creatures and a boss at the end.

seeds.name: Challenge Modes
seeds.description: Optional character challenges such as hardcore, slow XP, self-crafted gear and iron man, each with its own rewards.

seeds.name: Mythic Plus
seeds.description: Keystone-style dungeon runs with timers, rising difficulty levels, affixes and better loot as you climb.

seeds.name: Zone Difficulty
seeds.description: Tunes damage, healing and absorbs per map and phase, and adds a harder mode for selected raids and dungeons.

seeds.name: Event Bosses
seeds.description: GM-started events with custom bosses fought in their own phase, plus party-sized encounters.

seeds.name: 1v1 Arena
seeds.description: Adds a one-versus-one rated arena queue through an arena NPC.

seeds.name: 3v3 Solo Queue
seeds.description: Queue alone for 3v3 arena; the module builds balanced teams from the solo players waiting.

seeds.name: 1v1 PvP Queue
seeds.description: A 1v1 duel queue with best-of-three matches and matchmaking, written in Lua.

seeds.name: Deathroll
seeds.description: The classic roll-down dice game between two players, with its own window.

seeds.name: Treasure Chests
seeds.description: GMs hide chests with custom loot and hints for players to hunt down, with server announcements.

seeds.name: Crime and Bounty
seeds.description: Wanted levels for player crimes that persist and send NPC bounty hunters after the guilty.

seeds.name: Morphing Flask
seeds.description: A usable flask that turns the drinker into a random creature model for a while.

seeds.name: Duel Bets
seeds.description: Wager in-game gold on duels.
seeds.skip: not probed; wagering, left out by choice

seeds.name: Keira3
seeds.description: Desktop database editor for AzerothCore: creatures, quests, items, loot and gossip, with SQL output you can review.

seeds.name: Noggit
seeds.description: Map editor for the 3.3.5a terrain format: sculpt, paint textures, place models and edit water. You bring your own game files.
seeds.author: Noggit contributors

seeds.name: Database definitions (DBDefs)
seeds.description: Machine-readable layouts of the client's database tables for every build, 3.3.5a included; used by editors and tools.
seeds.author: DBDefs contributors

seeds.name: StormLib
seeds.description: C library for reading and writing MPQ archives; the basis of many patch and extraction tools.
seeds.author: Ladislav Zezula

seeds.name: Eluna-TS
seeds.description: Write realm scripts in TypeScript with typings, and compile them to Lua for the Eluna engine.

seeds.name: Module template
seeds.description: The starting template for a new AzerothCore module, with the folder layout, CMake hooks and a sample script.

seeds.name: Eluna
seeds.description: Lua scripting engine for server cores: hook events and script creatures, items and gossip without rebuilding.

seeds.name: ALE (Lua engine)
seeds.description: The AzerothCore Lua Engine, an Eluna-based module that runs Lua realm scripts on AzerothCore.

seeds.name: AIO
seeds.description: Sends addon code and messages between a Lua-scripted server and the game client, so a server script can ship its own UI.

seeds.name: AddOns Update Tool
seeds.description: Command-line updater for addons hosted on GitHub or GitLab, driven by a simple list file.

seeds.name: awesome_wotlk
seeds.description: A client-side library that adds newer interface functions (such as nameplate APIs) to the 3.3.5a client for addons to use.

seeds.name: Controller support
seeds.description: Gamepad play for the 3.3.5a client: sticks to move and look, a radial menu and a controller action bar. Client-side only.

seeds.name: Server Manager
seeds.description: Desktop app to manage an AzerothCore realm over SSH, MySQL and SOAP: start, stop, accounts and logs.

seeds.name: GM Monitor
seeds.description: Logs GM commands for review and shows them on a small web dashboard.

seeds.name: Discord Notifier
seeds.description: Posts chosen realm events and messages to a Discord channel through a webhook.

seeds.name: Better Item Reloading
seeds.description: Reload edited items on a running server, and in the client where the protocol allows it.

seeds.name: Test Realm Toolkit
seeds.description: An item for test realms that opens menus for levels, gear, teleports and other testing shortcuts.

seeds.name: MiniGM
seeds.description: Compact GM panel addon: common commands, a teleport list and playerbot controls in one window.

seeds.name: Improved Profession Capper
seeds.description: Shows the next recipe to craft to level a trade skill toward the cap, beside the profession window.

seeds.name: ClassicNumbers
seeds.description: Floating combat numbers with the older pop-up animation style.

seeds.name: RaidBrowser
seeds.description: Turns the unused raid tab of the social window into a raid finder that reads group adverts from chat.

seeds.name: Group Bulletin Board
seeds.description: Collects group requests from chat into one board, sorted by dungeon, so finding a group takes one look.

seeds.name: DialogUI
seeds.description: A larger, immersive window for quest, gossip and book text.

seeds.name: SoundAlerter Enhanced
seeds.description: Spoken alerts for important enemy spells and cooldowns, aimed at arena and battlegrounds.

seeds.name: Playerbots
seeds.description: Adds AI-driven player characters that quest, group, run dungeons and fill the world; needs its own core branch.

seeds.name: Dungeon Clear
seeds.description: Helps playerbot groups clear whole dungeons on their own.

seeds.name: Bot Level Brackets
seeds.description: Spreads playerbots across level ranges you set, so every bracket has company.

seeds.name: Classless and Wildcard
seeds.description: A classless system: learn spells and talents from other classes with scrolls bought for in-game gold.

seeds.name: AoE Loot
seeds.description: Loot every nearby corpse at once.

seeds.name: Solocraft
seeds.description: Scales a player's stats inside dungeons and raids to the group size, for small groups and solo players.

seeds.name: Solo LFG
seeds.description: Lets a single player queue for the Dungeon Finder.

seeds.name: Anticheat
seeds.description: Passive checks for speed, fly, teleport and similar hacks, with reports for GMs.

seeds.name: Learn Spells
seeds.description: Teaches class spells automatically on level-up, so no trainer trips.

seeds.name: Enchanter NPC
seeds.description: An NPC that enchants a player's gear from a menu.

seeds.name: Reagent Bank
seeds.description: An NPC that stores crafting reagents without using bag or bank slots.

seeds.name: Account Reagent Bank
seeds.description: An account-wide reagent bank with a companion addon, profession integration and shopping lists.

seeds.name: Assistant
seeds.description: An NPC that hands out heirlooms, glyphs and gems and offers profession help; prices are set by the realm owner.

seeds.name: Beastmaster NPC
seeds.description: An NPC that lets hunters pick tameable pets, including rare ones, from a menu.

seeds.name: Breaking News
seeds.description: Shows your own news panel on the character select screen.

seeds.name: Account Achievements
seeds.description: Shares achievements across all characters on an account.

seeds.name: Junk to Gold
seeds.description: Sells grey items for gold the moment they are looted.

seeds.name: Individual XP
seeds.description: Each player sets their own experience rate with a command.

seeds.name: Honor from Guards
seeds.description: Guards and elites give honor when killed in world PvP.

seeds.name: Skip Death Knight Start
seeds.description: Lets new death knights skip the starting quest chain.

seeds.name: No Hearthstone Cooldown
seeds.description: Resets the hearthstone cooldown right after use.

seeds.name: Dungeon Finder Expansion
seeds.description: Lets higher-level characters queue for the random dungeons of earlier level ranges.

seeds.name: Weekend Bonus
seeds.description: More experience, money, reputation and skill-ups on weekends, with announcements.

seeds.name: Character Tools
seeds.description: Items that let players change their race, faction or appearance and rename themselves.

seeds.name: Weapon Visuals
seeds.description: Lets players choose enchant glow effects on their weapons.

seeds.name: Reforging
seeds.description: Move part of one secondary stat on an item into another, as later expansions allow.

seeds.name: World Chat
seeds.description: A realm-wide chat channel, with faction options.

seeds.name: Cross-faction Battlegrounds
seeds.description: Fills battleground teams from both factions so queues pop faster.

seeds.name: Duel Reset
seeds.description: Restores health, mana and cooldowns after a duel.

seeds.name: PvP Titles
seeds.description: Awards the old PvP rank titles for honorable kills.

seeds.name: Played-time Rewards
seeds.description: Gives a reward item for every set amount of time played.

seeds.name: Buffer NPC
seeds.description: An NPC that casts a set of buffs on players.

seeds.name: Boss Announcer
seeds.description: Announces raid boss kills to the whole realm.

seeds.name: Auto Revive
seeds.description: Revives players automatically, for test or casual realms.

seeds.name: Level-up Fireworks
seeds.description: A firework show for players who reach a new level.

seeds.name: Desertion Warnings
seeds.description: Warns players before they leave a battleground early and take the deserter debuff.

seeds.name: Keep Out
seeds.description: Keeps players out of maps and zones you choose.

seeds.name: War Effort
seeds.description: A realm-wide collection event in which players hand in supplies to unlock content.

seeds.name: Custom Loot Choice
seeds.description: After a boss kill, players pick one item from its loot table themselves.

seeds.name: Flight Path Discovery
seeds.description: A board at flight masters to unlock nearby flight paths for in-game gold.

seeds.name: Guild Expansion
seeds.description: Guild levels and perks, work orders, contracts and a mission table, built for small and solo guilds; comes with an addon.

seeds.name: Lore Codex
seeds.description: A codex of the world's lore that unlocks as you explore, talk and quest; comes with an addon.

seeds.name: Level-up Rewards
seeds.description: Mails rewards to players who reach set levels, with a counter of who got there first.

seeds.name: Lua Auction Bot
seeds.description: Keeps the auction house stocked and buys from players, written in Lua.

seeds.name: Recruit a Friend
seeds.description: A standalone recruit-a-friend system with its own rewards.

seeds.name: Exchange NPC
seeds.description: An NPC that trades materials for other materials at rates you set.

seeds.name: MultiVendor
seeds.description: One NPC that opens several vendor lists from a menu.

seeds.name: Send and Bind
seeds.description: Lets GMs mail items to players already soulbound.

seeds.name: Bag o' Goods
seeds.description: A bag item that rolls random, level-appropriate loot.

seeds.name: Zone Check
seeds.description: Moves players out of zones you have closed.

seeds.name: Timed Announcements
seeds.description: Repeating announcements that a GM or the console starts and stops.

seeds.name: Carbon Copy
seeds.description: Lets players copy a character at its current stage, for example for low-level PvP.

seeds.name: Item Transmogrification
seeds.description: Change the look of gear to that of other items you own, through an NPC.

seeds.name: Zone Debuff
seeds.description: Applies a configurable debuff to players in chosen zones.

seeds.name: Loot Arbiter
seeds.description: Routes group loot to the player who can use it best.

seeds.name: Random Item Enchants (Lua)
seeds.description: Rolls random bonus enchants on weapons and armour when they drop.

seeds.name: Sit Means Rest
seeds.description: Sitting down slowly restores health and mana.

seeds.name: Beginner Companion
seeds.description: An in-game guide for new players with tips, a small wiki and progress rewards.

seeds.name: Loot Pet
seeds.description: A companion pet that loots corpses for you.

seeds.name: Level Stats
seeds.description: Grants a random primary stat bonus on each level-up.

seeds.name: Demon Morpher
seeds.description: Lets warlocks change the look of their demon pets.

seeds.name: Super Buffer NPC
seeds.description: A Lua NPC that buffs players on request.

seeds.name: Buffs and Loot Tweaks
seeds.description: A buff menu in two languages, loot multipliers and random buffs, with no SQL needed.

seeds.name: Level Reward
seeds.description: An item reward on each level-up, and weapon skills learned automatically.

seeds.name: Summon All
seeds.description: A GM command to summon every player, or a group, to one place.

seeds.name: Item Upgrader Template
seeds.description: A starting point for an NPC that upgrades items in steps.
